title: Completed integral scalar extension preserves standard cohomological bounds
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, $E\subset L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and chosen uniformizers $t,v$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and let $Y$ be a noetherian finite-dimensional scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible. Here noetherian means a finite affine cover by noetherian rings, finite-dimensional means a finite bound on chains of irreducible closed subsets, and invertibility is in each local ring. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], put $R=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_E/t^n)_Y$ and $S=\varprojlim_n(\mathcal O_L/v^n)_Y$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Use the full derived-complete constructible integral categories $\mathcal C_E=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ and $\mathcal C_L=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_L)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], with their bounded standard t-structures [prop-weil-pbc-integral-tstructure].

The actual strict-tower scalar-extension functor $T_{L/E}$ [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], whose value is
$$R\varprojlim_{m\ge1}\operatorname{Res}_m\bigl(K\otimes_R^L(\mathcal O_L/v^m)_Y\bigr),$$
is naturally isomorphic in $D(S)$ to ordinary derived change of rings $K\otimes_R^L S$, and is the restriction of the derived functor of the exact sheaf functor $M\mapsto M\otimes_R S$. It is an exact triangulated functor $\mathcal C_E\to\mathcal C_L$ with the induced shift comparison. For all integers $a\le b$ it sends $\mathcal C_E^{\le b}$ into $\mathcal C_L^{\le b}$ and $\mathcal C_E^{\ge a}$ into $\mathcal C_L^{\ge a}$. These assertions hold for arbitrary constructible $K$; no flatness of its cohomology is required.

proof.text: Use finiteFreeCompletedScalarComparison to identify the restricted completed coefficient algebra with a finite product of units. Convert this to the finite free module using the biproduct comparison and reindexing along ULift. The proved scalarFiniteExact helper of strict-tower transport applies to the canonical completedScalarCochainModel: restriction identifies ordinary extension with tensor by that finite free module, detects finite limits, and its ordinary adjunction gives finite colimits. This proves both named ordinary exactness instances.

The canonical completedScalarCochainModel supplies the existing ordinary derived extension and its universal counit on complexes. Exactness makes mapDerivedCategory, together with mapDerivedCategoryFactors, another left derived functor of the identical termwise extension. Apply Functor.leftDerivedUnique and leftDerivedNatTrans_app to obtain e from the published ordinary derived extension to mapDerivedCategory, with the required counit normalization on every complex. Reuse the proved scalar_exact_comparison helper of the point-derived-sections tensor-descent module; that helper itself is stated for an arbitrary scheme, with exactly these canonical functors and counits.

For each intrinsic integral constructible K, its first defining clause is intrinsic derived completeness. Choose an auxiliary finite field of prime characteristic greater than l, and apply sfDerivedComplete_iff_legacy. This supplies exactly IsDerivedCompleteUnrestricted, with no condition on the characteristic of Y. finiteFreeCompletedScalarComparison now makes the published chi_K invertible. Its naturality supplies an isomorphism beta from restricted ordinary derived extension to the published constructible strict-tower extension followed by inclusion. Construct epsilon as the inverse of e inverse followed by beta, so its inverse has the specified formula definitionally.

The intrinsic integral constructible category inherits shifts and triangles from its triangulated object property. The source inclusion followed by mapDerivedCategory is triangulated. Apply Functor.CommShift.ofComp to epsilon and the fully faithful target inclusion to equip the actual restricted strict-tower functor with its induced shift comparison. Its compatibility theorem gives NatTrans.CommShift epsilon.hom. Then Functor.isTriangulated_iff_comp_right gives triangulatedness of that functor.

For each K and each upper bound b, the exact ordinary functor satisfies isLE_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Transport this bound through epsilon_K inverse using the standard derived t-structure. Independently apply isGE_mapDerivedCategory_obj and the same isomorphism to the lower bound a. These are exactly the ambient bounds already written in the Lean statement; neither an induced integral t-structure nor a comparison with the other constructible presentation is needed. The argument applies to any scheme, so the stated geometric hypotheses need not be used.

lean.statement: theorem podCompletedScalarExtension_tExact [AlgebraicGeometry.IsNoetherian Y] (_hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ n) (_hinv : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y)) : ∃ e : completedDerivedScalarExtension l E L ι Y ≅ (completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι Y).mapDerivedCategory, (∀ P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E Y) ℤ, e.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ (completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι Y).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P = completedScalarCounit l E L ι Y P) ∧ ∃ (_σ : (sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l)) E L ι Y).CommShift ℤ), (sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l)) E L ι Y).IsTriangulated ∧ ∃ ε : sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l)) E L ι Y ⋙ (sfIntegralConstructible l L Y).ι ≅ (sfIntegralConstructible l E Y).ι ⋙ (completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι Y).mapDerivedCategory, (∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y, ε.inv.app K = e.inv.app K.obj ≫ (completedScalarComparison l E L ι Y).app K.obj) ∧ NatTrans.CommShift ε.hom ℤ ∧ ∀ (a b : ℤ), a ≤ b → ∀ K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y, (DerivedCategory.IsLE K.obj b → DerivedCategory.IsLE ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l)) E L ι Y).obj K).obj b) ∧ (DerivedCategory.IsGE K.obj a → DerivedCategory.IsGE ((sfConstructibleIntegralScalarExtension (l + 1) l (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self l)) E L ι Y).obj K).obj a)
